name: Kagefumi
source:
A boy and a girl meet each other and promise to go together to the festival. But boy has demonic power dwelling inside him...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
少年與少女相遇，約好一起去參加祭典。然而，少年體內卻潛藏著惡魔的力量……
